title: Finitely presented families over reduced bases admit smooth strata near a generic point after a finite locally free radicial cover
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: A purely inseparable extension of the generic residue field must be realized by a tower of finite locally free universally injective covers on an open neighbourhood. The proof then descends all generic closed strata simultaneously and shrinks to preserve closed immersion, thickening and smoothness conditions.
